title: hydrolog-precip-pmaxtp/1
description: The PMAXTP depth of IMGW-PIB that `precip pmaxtp` fetches through Obserwator for a point, a duration and a probability, with the source line the terms of PMAXTP prescribe (ADR-0018, ADR-0028); the envelope's `attribution` and `terms_notice` have every line. Unknown fields are allowed: adding optional fields keeps the version (AGI-4.1).
